build_service_class: build a protocol service class from a ServiceDescriptor using the GeneratedServiceType metaclass
build_service_stub_class: build a protocol service stub class from a ServiceDescriptor using the GeneratedServiceStubType metaclass
call_method_on_service: call a service method by its descriptor using the CallMethod wrapper on a service instance
get_request_response_classes: get the request or response protocol message class for a given method descriptor
generate_stub_method: generate a stub method that delegates RPC calls through an RpcChannel for a service method
